name: ptycho_weak_lensing
summary: Weak lensing as a spin-2 inverse problem (Kaiser-Squires, E/B, nulls, calibration) plus a ptychographic reconstruction of kappa from overlapping pointings, an intensity-only variant, and polarization Q+iU through the same E/B machinery.

provenance.origin: Cody, 2026-11-12: weak lensing 'may already be a type of implemented ptychography'; the experiment needs a calculated mass map to match against published shear/DM maps (control) and a polarization vector field as a separate image of the same experiment. Maths ESTABLISHED (Kaiser & Squires 1993; Seitz & Schneider 2001); the pointings-as-probes ePIE reading and the modulus variant are THEORETICAL.

constants.role: intrinsic ellipticity dispersion per component (shape noise)
lensing efficiency D_ls/D_s scaling kappa and gamma

environment.native_space: flat-sky tangent plane; spin-2 complex fields (gamma, epsilon, Q+iU)
environment.arithmetic: numpy float64 / complex128; FFT with zero padding; mass sheet (k=0) not measured

menu.label: Ptycho-Weak-Lensing (shear, mass map, pointings, polarization)
menu.blurb: Simulates a lens, observes it through overlapping pointings with shape noise, recovers the mass map by Kaiser-Squires and by a ptychographic iteration, and checks it against E/B, rotation, calibration

tools.name: verify
tools.label: Verify
tools.desc: Runs the exact self-checks of the lensing algebra against closed-form results

tools.name: forward
tools.label: Forward
tools.desc: Builds the projected NFW convergence and returns its tangential shear profile

tools.name: reconstruct
tools.label: Reconstruct
tools.desc: Draws shape-noise-limited galaxies from a synthetic merger, inverts, reports correlation and B-mode leak

tools.name: null_tests
tools.label: Null Tests
tools.desc: Applies the standard null tests to one catalogue and reports each channel against the noise floor

tools.name: calibrate
tools.label: Calibrate
tools.desc: Recovers a known multiplicative shear bias from a catalogue of random galaxies

tools.name: ptycho
tools.label: Ptycho
tools.desc: Observes the synthetic cluster through overlapping pointings, reconstructs by ePIE/Kaczmarz, compares with nai

tools.name: modulus
tools.label: Modulus
tools.desc: Phase retrieval of the lens from the shear modulus with different starting guesses

tools.name: polarization
tools.label: Polarization
tools.desc: Builds a potential-born spin-2 polarization field, takes its E/B, and correlates it with the shear E-mode

tools.name: efficiency
tools.label: Efficiency
tools.desc: Returns the lensing efficiency of a source plane behind a lens
